title: Senior Graphic Designer

sections.heading: Senior Graphic Designer
paragraphs: Job Title: Graphic Designer (5+ Years Experience)
Location: New Cairo
Job Type: Full-Time
Department: Creative Team
Key Responsibilities:
• Lead Brand Identity: Take ownership of our brands, ensuring every design is consistent, polished, and strategically aligned.
• Performance-First Design: Create high-impact visuals for Instagram, TikTok, and web that don't just look good but actually drive results.
• Video & Motion Content: Bring static designs to life by editing short-form videos and motion graphics that fit current social trends.
• Cross-Team Collaboration: Work hand-in-hand with our marketing and performance teams to turn strategy into scroll-stopping creative.
• Visual Storytelling: Maintain a high standard for storytelling, ensuring our visual style remains cohesive across all touchpoints.
• Project Delivery: Manage your workflow to deliver top-tier assets in line with our content calendars and deadlines.
• Experience: At least 5 years of professional design experience, specifically with a heavy focus on branding.
• Hybrid Skillset: Expert-level graphic design skills paired with solid experience in video editing.
• Software Mastery: Total comfort with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) and video tools like Premiere Pro or After Effects.
• Strategic Eye: A deep understanding of how branding and visual design impact performance marketing goals.
• Efficiency: Ability to stay organized and deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment.
• Detail-Oriented: A sharp eye for the small things that make a design feel premium and professional.

title: Social Media Moderator

sections.heading: Social Media Moderator
paragraphs: Job Title: Full-Time Social Media Moderator
Location: New Cairo
Department: Creative Team
Key Responsibilities:
•Monitor comments, messages, and community interactions across social platforms.
•Respond to audience inquiries professionally and on time.
•Maintain brand voice and ensure a positive online community.
•Remove spam, offensive, or inappropriate content.
•Escalate sensitive issues to the relevant teams when needed.
•Track audience feedback, trends, and community sentiment.
•Collaborate with content, marketing, and customer support teams.
• 1+ years of experience in moderation, community management, or customer support.
• Strong written communication and problem-solving skills.
• Familiar with Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, and X/Twitter.
• Ability to multitask and handle fast-paced online interactions.
• Experience with moderation or social media tools.
Personal Skills:
• Strong communication and emotional intelligence.
• Patient, professional, and detail-oriented.
• Adaptable to trends and platform updates.
• Team player with a passion for community building.

title: Video Editor

sections.heading: Video Editor
paragraphs: Job Title: Video Editor (2–4 Years Experience)
Location: New Cairo
Job Type: Full-Time
Department: Creative Team
Key Responsibilities:
Edit and produce high-quality video content for social media, ads, campaigns, and brand storytelling.
Collaborate with the creative, marketing, and design teams to bring concepts to life.
Assemble raw footage into polished final versions using tools like Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut, CapCut.
Add motion graphics, sound design, and color grading to enhance video quality.
Adapt video content to suit different platforms and formats (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, etc.).
Maintain consistency in style, branding, and storytelling across all video outputs.
Stay up to date with video trends, editing techniques, and creative storytelling methods.
2–4 years of experience in video editing, preferably in a digital marketing or creative agency.
Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or CapCut.
Strong knowledge of motion graphics software such as After Effects.
A solid portfolio showcasing video editing work, including ads, reels, campaigns, and branded content.
Creativity, attention to detail, and ability to follow brand guidelines.
Strong communication and time management skills.
Experience in animation or 3D video editing.
Familiarity with social media algorithms and performance-driven video content.
Knowledge of audio editing and advanced sound design.

title: accountant-tax-experience

sections.heading: Accountant (Tax Experience)
paragraphs: Job Title: Part-Time Accountant (Tax & Financial Reporting)
Location: New Cairo / Hybrid
Job Type: Part-Time
Key Requirements:
• Bachelor’s in Accounting or Finance
• 1–3 years of experience in taxation (corporate & VAT)
• Familiar with Egyptian tax law, electronic invoice system, and preparing tax returns
• Experience with accounting software (Excel, Zoho Books, QuickBooks, or Odoo)
• Strong communication & reporting skills
• Young male accountant (early to mid-20s)
• Organized, punctual, and detail-oriented
• Flexible mindset — able to handle digital agency structure (projects, invoices, freelancers)
Responsibilities:
• Manage invoices, receipts & monthly reconciliations
• Prepare tax filings (VAT, Withholding, Income tax)
• Coordinate with external auditors or tax consultants
• Support monthly financial reports
• Ensure compliance with Egyptian financial regulations
